system.description: Swarm COHESION When a swarm takes damage, the seething mass of creatures is momentarily dispersed, but not all of them return. At the start of an encounter that includes one or more swarms, place one tracking token for each swarm on space 8 of the swarm cohesion track. For each successful attack that causes damage to a swarm, move its token one space to the right along the track. Swarms When the cohesion token reaches space 6, 4, or 2, the swarm immediately suffers a wound. This damage is in addition to the damage inflicted by the attack that caused the token to move. If the cohesion token reaches space 0, the swarm has been disrupted to the point that the individual creatures comprising the swarm flee for the safety of their lair. If multiple swarms are present in an encounter, it might be helpful to use the different coloured sides of the trackers, assigning each swarm a colour and then placing a token of the same colour on the beast’s card.
